006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
009
010import java.util.List;
011
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
017import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
018import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
019import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IStringItem;
020import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
021import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
022
023// CPD-OFF
024/**
025 * Implements the XPath 3.1 <a href=
026 * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-substring-after">fn:substring-after</a>
027 * function.
028 */
029public final class FnSubstringAfter {
030  private static final String NAME = "substring-after";
031  @NonNull
032  static final IFunction SIGNATURE_TWO_ARG = IFunction.builder()
033      .name(NAME)
034      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
035      .deterministic()
036      .contextIndependent()
037      .focusIndependent()
038      .argument(IArgument.builder()
039          .name("arg1")
040          .type(IStringItem.type())
041          .zeroOrOne()
042          .build())
043      .argument(IArgument.builder()
044          .name("arg2")
045          .type(IStringItem.type())
046          .zeroOrOne()
047          .build())
048      .returnType(IStringItem.type())
049      .returnOne()
050      .functionHandler(FnSubstringAfter::executeTwoArg)
051      .build();
052  // CPD-ON
053
054  private FnSubstringAfter() {
055    // disable construction
056  }
057
058  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
059  @NonNull
060  private static ISequence<IStringItem> executeTwoArg(
061      @NonNull IFunction function,
062      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
063      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
064      IItem focus) {
065
066    // From the XPath 3.1 specification:
067    // If the value of $arg1 or $arg2 is the empty sequence, or contains only
068    // ignorable collation units, it is interpreted as the zero-length string.
069    IStringItem arg1 = arguments.get(0).isEmpty()
070        ? IStringItem.valueOf("")
071        : FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.notNull(arguments.get(0).getFirstItem(true)));
072    IStringItem arg2 = arguments.get(1).isEmpty()
073        ? IStringItem.valueOf("")
074        : FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.notNull(arguments.get(1).getFirstItem(true)));
075
076    return ISequence.of(IStringItem.valueOf(fnSubstringAfter(arg1.asString(), arg2.asString())));
077  }
078
079  /**
080   * An implementation of XPath 3.1 <a href=
081   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-substring-after">fn:substring-after</a>.
082   *
083   * @param arg1
084   *          the source string to get a substring from
085   * @param arg2
086   *          the substring to match and find the substring to return after the
087   *          match
088   * @return the substring
089   */
090  @NonNull
091  public static String fnSubstringAfter(
092      @NonNull String arg1,
093      @NonNull String arg2) {
094    return ObjectUtils.notNull(StringUtils.substringAfter(arg1, arg2));
095  }
096}
